Nitrokey is a Berlin based vendor that has built its reputation on open hardware and open source firmware. Their current generation is the Nitrokey 3, which uses a Common Criteria EAL6+ certified secure element and supports FIDO2, U2F, OpenPGP smart card, PIV, OATH, and a broad set of cryptographic primitives including secp256k1. The newer Nitrokey Passkey is a simpler, FIDO only device that replaces the older Nitrokey FIDO2 line.
